body.html: Waste bins and tissue box covers as part of your interior. Materials and colours that feel naturally at home in the space.

media.alt: Coordinated room collection with a dark brown waste bin, tissue cover and tray.

body.html: Hotel OS&E includes the familiar essentials: waste bins, tissue box covers and everyday organisers. We develop these accessories around your room scheme and have them handmade in the EU. A single suite or a very small addition is as welcome as an extensive guest-room commission.
A functional object that belongs within the interior. Its specification is considered alongside the room, its use and the surrounding accessories.

media.alt: Waste bin with a brown exterior — product photograph with an edited setting

body.html: Everyday consumables sit behind a coordinated finish. The cover is specified for your chosen tissue refill and its intended location.

media.alt: Tissue box covers in wood and covered finishes — product photograph with an edited setting

body.html: Choose from genuine Italian leather, high-quality PU and other materials available for the product. We use samples to agree colour, finish and construction for your accessory.
Blind debossing presses the design into the surface without colour. Foil stamping adds a coloured or metallic finish. We agree the method, size and position to suit the material.
Find individual models, material choices and specification options in our complete accessory collection.
